description: ENVIRONMENT: the four SecOps roles exist (three read-only specialists + security-reviewer, reused)
ENVIRONMENT: dep-triage, secret-triage, posture-auditor declare no Edit/Write in their tools list — read-only is structural, not a promise in prose
command: ok=1; for f in dep-triage secret-triage posture-auditor; do line=$(grep '^tools:' .claude/agents/$f.md 2>/dev/null); echo "$line" | grep -q '"Edit"' && ok=0; echo "$line" | grep -q '"Write"' && ok=0; done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: ENVIRONMENT: remediation-engineer is the only SecOps role declaring both Edit and Write — separation of duties made structural (M9)
command: line=$(grep '^tools:' .claude/agents/remediation-engineer.md 2>/dev/null); echo "$line" | grep -q '"Edit"' && echo "$line" | grep -q '"Write"' && echo pass || echo fail

description: ENVIRONMENT: secfinding-style skill states the ranking rubric — reachability/exposure/blast-radius, never CVSS alone
command: grep -qi 'reachability' .claude/skills/secfinding-style/SKILL.md && grep -qi 'blast radius' .claude/skills/secfinding-style/SKILL.md && grep -qi 'exposure' .claude/skills/secfinding-style/SKILL.md && grep -qiE 'never.*cvss|not.*an axis|cvss.*not' .claude/skills/secfinding-style/SKILL.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: ENVIRONMENT: the reachability-check skill's deterministic script exists and is executable
ORACLE: reachability-check returns reachable=no for PyYAML against the planted fixture — nothing imports it, so it is noise regardless of CVSS
command: OUT=$(bash .claude/skills/reachability-check/scripts/reachability-check.sh --lang py --import yaml --root platform/secfixtures/vulnerable-service 2>/dev/null | grep '^reachable='); echo "${OUT:-no-output}"

description: ORACLE: reachability-check returns reachable=yes for requests against the planted fixture — imported at app.py:1 and called at app.py:8, the real finding
command: OUT=$(bash .claude/skills/reachability-check/scripts/reachability-check.sh --lang py --import requests --root platform/secfixtures/vulnerable-service 2>/dev/null | grep '^reachable='); echo "${OUT:-no-output}"

description: ORACLE: the release-gate-secops hook denies a deploy-shaped Bash command while a verdict on disk records an unresolved critical finding
command: TMPV=$(mktemp); printf '{"findings":[{"rank":1,"severity_class":"critical","status":"open"}]}' > "$TMPV"; OUT=$(printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml"}}' | SECOPS_VERDICT_FILE="$TMPV" .claude/hooks/release-gate-secops.sh 2>/dev/null); rm -f "$TMPV"; echo "$OUT" | grep -q '"permissionDecision":"deny"' && echo pass || echo "${OUT:-no-output}"

description: ORACLE (negative): the same gate allows the deploy through once the verdict records the critical as resolved — the gate reads judgement, it does not itself judge
command: TMPV=$(mktemp); printf '{"findings":[{"rank":1,"severity_class":"critical","status":"resolved"}]}' > "$TMPV"; printf '%s' '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml"}}' | SECOPS_VERDICT_FILE="$TMPV" .claude/hooks/release-gate-secops.sh >/dev/null 2>/tmp/m15-gate-rc; RC=$?; rm -f "$TMPV"; [ "$RC" = 0 ] && echo pass || echo "rc-$RC"

description: ENVIRONMENT: the secfindings MCP server and its tool manifest exist
ENVIRONMENT: the secfindings tool manifest declares read_only:true and every tool has kind:read
command: jq -e '.read_only == true and ([.tools[].kind] | all(. == "read"))' platform/mcp-servers/secfindings/tools.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR TOOL: the secfindings server exposes exactly findings_query, finding_get, corpus_summary — three reads and no write
command: OUT=$(printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}' | node platform/mcp-servers/secfindings/server.js 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.id==2) | .result.tools[].name' | sort | tr '\n' ' '); [ "$OUT" = 'corpus_summary finding_get findings_query ' ] && echo pass || echo "${OUT:-no-output}"

description: NEGATIVE: a write-shaped tools/call (finding_resolve) is rejected because no such tool exists in the interface — the read-only boundary is structural, not a permission check
command: OUT=$(printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":9,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"finding_resolve","arguments":{"id":"x"}}}' | node platform/mcp-servers/secfindings/server.js 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.id==9) | (.error.message // "OK")'); echo "$OUT" | grep -qi 'unknown tool' && echo pass || echo "${OUT:-no-output}"

description: ENVIRONMENT: the planted vulnerable-service fault set and scan.sh exist, with scan.sh executable
command: [ -d platform/secfixtures/vulnerable-service ] && [ -x platform/secfixtures/scan.sh ] && [ -f platform/secfixtures/ground-truth.md ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR BRIEF: agentops/secops/BRIEF.md exists and states what done means for this review
command: F=agentops/secops/BRIEF.md; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -qiE 'done' "$F" && grep -qiE 'means|definition|criteria|ship' "$F" && echo pass || echo incomplete

description: YOUR FINDINGS: agentops/secops/findings.json ranks the CVSS 6.1 requests finding (CVE-2023-32681) ABOVE the CVSS 9.8 PyYAML finding (CVE-2020-14343) — the measurable claim this module makes
command: F=agentops/secops/findings.json; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; OUT=$(jq -r 'def rankof(pat): ([.[] | select(((.finding // "")+" "+(.component // "")+" "+(.evidence // "")) | test(pat)) | (.rank|tostring|tonumber?)] | first); (rankof("CVE-2023-32681")) as $req | (rankof("CVE-2020-14343")) as $pyyaml | if ($req != null and $pyyaml != null and $req < $pyyaml) then "pass" else "fail" end' "$F" 2>/dev/null); echo "${OUT:-fail}"

description: YOUR FINDINGS: every reachability verdict (yes/no) in findings.json carries file:line evidence, not an eyeballed guess
command: F=agentops/secops/findings.json; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; OUT=$(jq -r '[.[] | select(.reachable=="yes" or .reachable=="no")] as $arr | (($arr|length) > 0) and ($arr | map((.evidence // "") | test(":[0-9]+")) | all)' "$F" 2>/dev/null); echo "${OUT:-false}"

description: YOUR DECISION: agentops/secops/verdict.json records a ship/no-ship verdict, and names what blocks when it withholds ship
command: F=agentops/secops/verdict.json; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; OUT=$(jq -r '((.verdict=="ship") or (.verdict=="no-ship")) and ((.blocking|type)=="array") and (if .verdict=="no-ship" then (.blocking|length)>0 else true end)' "$F" 2>/dev/null); echo "${OUT:-false}"

description: YOUR MEASUREMENT: agentops/secops/measurement.md records where the agent's ranking disagreed with ground-truth.md
command: F=agentops/secops/measurement.md; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -qiE 'ground.truth' "$F" && grep -qiE 'disagree|miss|wrong|differ|incorrect' "$F" && echo pass || echo incomplete
